decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation extends the core laser offer and is still listed on the website, so with growing turnover and available slack there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources, although its lower website prominence suggests a modest risk of consolidation.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core business and has kept its own product page for two years, which signals performance at or above aspiration.
The piezo inkjet printer has had a dedicated page for two years and complements the firm's established inkjet range, so no problemistic search is warranted.
This flagship laser line is shown on the home page and is central to the firm's strategic direction, so management will commit resources to it even while its results are still uncertain.
The newly launched laser cabin has its own page and fits the laser expansion, and the firm's expansion slack lets it carry the product while its results develop.
The Blechexpo Best Award gives the lubricant printing system external legitimacy above aspiration, and the firm's growth gives it slack to develop this niche.
